newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lawyer L'Helias will vote for Eurotunnel debt plan.
newsitem.headline: Lawyer L'Helias will vote for Eurotunnel debt plan.

text.p: French lawyer Sophie L'Helias said in a statement that her Franklin Global Investor Services, proxy holder for various institutional investors, would not vote against the debt restructuring plan of Eurotunnel.

L'Helias, a forceful advocate for corporate governance in France, said that a statement by the Finance and Economy Ministry on Tuesday "makes it impossible for FGIS to vote against the restructuring plan that will be put to the shareholders on July 10."
She said that the governments said in the statement that they would not oppose the banks taking control of Eurotunnel if the shareholders did not accept the restructuring deal.
An assistant to L'Helias could not say how many shares she represented.
On Monday, one of L'Helias clients -- Northern Cross which holds over three percent on Eurotunnel -- said it would vote in favour of the debt pact.
